request: Bomb damage also applies to enemies entering during the live display.

decisions.bomb: One existing-strength damage packet per target per bomb, including new or newly visible enemies; slot reuse resets eligibility. No damage outside the active interval.
decisions.title: Up/down chooses START or STAGE SELECT; left/right wraps all seven stages; A/START opens character selection; B returns with selection preserved; START begins at the first campaign stage.
